K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
Don't be so sour, Dongbaek. Liveliness is good to have.
冬柏，别说这种话。有活力可是件好事。

Some considered the assemblage to be mere noise... // Some did not welcome it...
有人觉得这种喧闹是噪音……//有人并不欢迎这种喧哗……

While some considered the commotion to be growth. // And some saw it as a step in a new direction.
有些人觉得这不过是正在增长的混乱。//而有些人觉得这是踏入崭新未来的一步。

As for me... I saw it slantwise as always.
而对我而言……我只是予以侧目，一如既往。

As heavy rain might pour for days after a spell of clear skies...
正如晴日之后，亦可有持续数日的暴雨……

I saw no meaning in attempting to fathom the caprices of the weather.
试图了解变化无常的天气，在我看来是毫无意义的。

I would simply wait for things to calm, looking out for the day's arrival.
我仅是等待那风雨平息，仅是抬首等待。
